notes.title: ACT 3 BETA 0.8 (JULY 30TH UPDATE) - CUTSCENES IN ACT 3! PORTALS!!
notes.notes:
[p]Gamers, sorry for the delay. Took some extra time to get cutscenes back together and get back into gear for working on this game. After 3 months straight of long hours working on it, I had a little bit of burnout, but now I’m back in it 100 percent to the end! The game will come out August 22nd, which is an unfortunate delay, but necessary since I randomly decided to add the final evolution of the Uncle Kenny gameplay sandbox, portals![/p][p][/p][p]We are in the endgame. I can’t believe it's actually going to come out. It's been delayed just so damn much. But this is the best version of the game that could have existed. For my first ever video game, I’m extremely proud of everything I was able to accomplish. I wouldn’t have been able to do it without the amazing circle around me, helping add extra songs, graphics, and voice acting to the game. Thank you to everyone[/p][p][i][b] NOTE TO ALL RETURNING PLAYERS: DELETE YOUR SAVEMENU SAVE FILE! GO TO %localappdata% using the Windows + R keys tool, then relaunch Uncle Kenny The Game!![/b][/i][/p][list][*][p]The first set of Act 3 cutscenes are in! It’s about half, a solid start! Shoutout Kenny Rogers for drawing them. The cutscenes go up until the start of the UNDERGROUND level for now.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now finally control the sound effect and music volume in the options menu![/p][/*][*][p]The phone call feature is now available in Act 1, something that has been teased for over a year. It’s a small bonus consisting of three mini cutscenes throughout Act 1[/p][/*][*][p]Portals have been added into the game! With that, a set of new levels has been added to the Underground area that introduces them, some of them inspired by the gameplay loop of the classic game Portal. [/p][/*][*][p]The first round of in-game dialogue has been added![/p][/*][*][p]Portals have been added to several late-game levels to spice them up.[/p][/*][*][p]The final mission now has extra portal-based levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons now have realistic sounds![/p][/*][*][p]When switching weapons, there’s now a reloading sound effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Cats have been added to the game! Give them a pet! For now there's Boots in the main menu, and Donald in Carl's Shop! Thank you Ava! More to come August 15th[/p][/*][*][p]Snail shells will now damage enemies when you jump on them.[/p][/*][*][p]New small levels have been added to work with the new cutscenes. For example, the president level now has a cultist introduction shootout.[/p][/*][*][p]The rage ability has been slightly scaled back to only be available during the Vengeance level. It was never too useful of a mechanic, players and myself forgot it existed half the time, and I couldn’t really find a place for it story or gameplay wise outside of where it was introduced. But I think it works better as a one-off.[/p][/*][*][p]Added graphics in some of the levels! Including flowers in Act 1! Thank you Ava![/p][/*][*][p]Hundreds of little fixes to the game, a huge push for polish[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]WHAT TO EXPECT FOR 0.9, AUGUST 15TH![/b][/p][list][*][p]Finalized final boss graphics[/p][/*][*][p]Most or all of the cutscenes.[/p][/*][*][p]A couple new tracks from Othon and Matthew[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Mina voice lines[/p][/*][*][p]Final mission in-game dialogue[/p][/*][*][p]A couple new levels including portal challenges in the late stages of the game
[/p][p][b]WHAT TO EXPECT FOR 1.0 LAUNCH, AUGUST 22ND!![/b][/p][/*][*][p]First wave of new skins for Uncle Kenny[/p][/*][*][p]Interactive Uncle Kenny comic book museum[/p][/*][*][p]Any remaining outstanding issues or fixes!!!![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]SONG OF THE UPDATE!!![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="SXKlJuO07eM;rightthumb"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]THANK YOU GAMERS................................... SEEE YOU AUGUST 15TH!!! LETS FUCKING GO[/p]

notes.title: ACT 3 BETA 0.6 (JUNE 15TH UPDATE) - HAPPY FATHER’S DAY!
notes.notes:
[p]This update has the final planned gameplay addition! We are so close now! Only the last level, and the final boss fight are left! Act 3 is long as hell now. I think the game was missing boss encounters, and their addition gives me a feeling of finality and content richness that I have never felt before with this game. It’s becoming a complete package, and by June 30, all of the planned levels should be in. I'm sure the final boss will need work through July. But having every playable space in there in some way will be a massive closure for me. We are in the end times.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]What's New?[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]When you are close to a crate or other solid objects that you can throw, it will indicate yellow to show you which one has been selected, which I’m a massive fan of.[/p][/*][*][p]2 new boss fights, Hank the Survival Guy, and a twin boss.[/p][/*][*][p]Facility and underground levels are even further expanded with a new gameplay mechanic, player movable platforms[/p][/*][*][p]Vengeance level has been extended and mostly completed.[/p][/*][*][p]New short level called lockpick has been added, gives a second of wind down time before the vengeance level[/p][/*][*][p]The first 6 levels of the final mission have been added roughly. There will be scenes between the levels to give context to each situation. [/p][/*][*][p]Rage ability has been tweaked with. More tweaks to it will come.[/p][/*][*][p]Telepathy directional throwing has bug fixes, where previously some vertical and horizontal speeds could bleed over.[/p][/*][*][p]With that, a new directional indicator shows up when picking up objects telepathically and greatly polishes the radiation throw mechanic[/p][/*][*][p]When companions are downed, an indication is now on screen that should make it easier to tell when it happens and where they are.[/p][/*][*][p]Backgrounds should have the proper snow below the snow background sprite instead of a gap below it.[/p][/*][*][p]Jumping out of a grapple jump with jetpack fuel should still give you solid momentum instead of going straight into a jetpack jump like before.[/p][/*][*][p]New phosphorus gas army man variant in the final mission. [/p][/*][*][p]Along with that, zombies have been brought back briefly as well.[/p][/*][*][p]New vase-style objects that drop coins when broken. Will be expanded on for sure.[/p][/*][*][p]Instead of an up arrow, the level up indication is now straight up text.[/p][/*][*][p]Desert level phosphorous bombs aren’t as brutal[/p][/*][*][p]Countless bug fixes and changes I can’t recall right now.
[/p][/*][/list][p]The first round of voice acting has been recorded! There will need to be several more sessions. The script is 37 pages long and still getting longer.  And cutscenes have barely even been started. But that’s what the majority of July will go towards. Giving context and bringing life to the gameplay situations and levels of Act 3 will be so satisfying. I’ve been thinking of these levels for years. It’s finally happening. Thank you for sticking with me.[/p][p][/p][p]Song of the update:[/p][previewyoutube="ZxjTC0bmKls;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Gamers, enjoy your father's day. Hell yeah. See you June 30th[/p]

notes.title: UNCLE KENNY BETA 0.5 (MAY 30TH) RELEASE!!
notes.notes:
Gamers, this update has come after some juicy and critical playtests that have me going back and adding to levels that I had previously thought were completed. In that process, I’ve developed a few new fun gameplay mechanics and I’m super excited to get them out for the masses. I’m definitely pushing the limits of what defines Uncle Kenny level design, something that has been lacking from Act 3 thus far. We’re at 0.5 now! That marks halfway through this Beta process. Although, I would argue that we are closer to 1.0 than it looks. 

[b]WHATS NEW GAMER - [/b]
- Upgrade system has been majorly overhauled after extensive playtesting. Instead of level gating, the special upgrades unlock once the player has completed an amount of tasks in gameplay. This change should encourage players to seek out upgrades to their favorite weapons and gameplay mechanics.
- Cultists and Cultist Parasite Zombies now speak! More voices to come for them and army men
- Armor now requires a threshold of parries to upgrade.
- There is a new bossfight, the Uber Tank, when you get the rocket launcher.
- The Underground section now has several platforming and reflex based levels that greatly spice up the pacing.
- Similarly, the facility level now has platforming levels akin to the no weapon pace-breaker in act one, but this time with a few twists.
- The desert section has been expanded and now includes a set piece involving phosphorous bombs.
- Three new “racing” levels have been added to the vehicle section that encourage fast speeds to offset the more stop and shoot of the core shooting levels.
- The Hoverbike/Speeder can change directions faster and is overall more smooth to control.
- There is now a final set of speed and damage upgrades to each weapon after purchasing the special upgrade. Golden skin to come once all upgrades are purchased.
- A countless number of small balance changes after playtests. The following are some examples.
Parrying is buffed. Instead of upgrades in the shop, the upgrades are now automatically applied from the start.
- Parasite nest health lowered
- Grapple hook spots added to armory level to add more options during combat.
- Geode Crystals now come towards you even when stuck in the wall
- The music in the vehicle level should play correctly
- Leveling up takes slightly less time at every level.
- An enormous number of extra changes I can’t really even recall. So much time has been going into this game that a lot of tweaks are hard to even remember. We’re starting to get pretty close to the end.



	Song of the update:
[previewyoutube=kaQN_tkV90k;full][/previewyoutube]


Gamers, enjoy! I’m loving this game by this point. The new mechanics and skill tree is a huge improvement over what was there just 15 days ago. Development is going well. This is looking like a final push for real this time.

[b]Here is the Uncle Kenny Beta Roadmap as of the launch of 0.3- [/b]

May 15th (0.4) - Finished Smoke level (DARK, FLASHLIGHTS LEVEL), Finished Underground level (RPG LEVEL), Updated Desert Flashback level.
               * Act 3 enemy dialogue!
               * New Background tiles by Othon

May 30th (0.5) - Hoverbike Additions, Helipad Dialogue (Uncle Kenny nephews dialogue)

June 15th (0.6) - Paperman vehicle mini-boss, Finished Vengeance Level (Not currently in game at all)

June 30th (0.7) - Finished Desert Level,  Hank Boss Fight

July 15th (0.8) - Finished Suicide Mission Level (Not currently in game at all), start work on final boss

July 30th (0.9) - Cutscenes in the game, Final Boss Finished, new levels to Facility (Parasite enemies level)

August 15th (FULL RELEASE 3.0) - Polish, Bug Fixes, game will be $4.99  


With all that out of the way... lets begin with Patch Notes of 0.3!!!


[b]ACT  3- [/b]
[list]
[*]Follower AI is now in the game! The kids can now run and shoot and talk!
[*]The hoverbike now fires its own weapons instead of yours, vastly improving gameplay
[*]Hoverbike engine is a little bit quieter to save everyone's ears
[*]Hoverbike level has a goal now to break 3 cores, which will open the door at the end. There are now sentry shotguns that disable when the cores go down.
[*]Desert level now has sandbag-like objects that break when hit with gunfire or grenades. Thinking about adding this to other levels once they are completed.
[*]Tanks have more health.
[*]Fixed music at the facility level.
[*]Fixed some audio glitches
[*]Buff army guys have been worked on, have a better AI and take more damage.
[*]Pigeon Man slight boss tweaks.
[*]Crates now drop rocket launcher ammo, but there will always only be one rocket
[*]Introduced rage mode, which will appear late in the game, but as of this update can be used whenever you want when you get telepathy. Enemies are afraid of you, and you deal three times as much damage for 9 seconds! Returns back after 3 minutes.
[*]You can no longer go as high above the level to stop from players skipping content and potential crash issues.
[*]It takes slightly less XP to reach the higher levels since there have been some cuts to the levels planned
[*]Having co-op mode enabled in the menu no longer reduces Uncle Kenny’s health in act 3.
[*]Now co-op is properly reflected as not supported with Act 3. 
[*]Number keys are fixed
[*]Each weapon now has a proper color, shows up when picking up ammo and when switching weapons
[*]Laser gun design altered, has higher damage but lower ammo capacity and pickup amounts. As it stood the laser gun didn’t have as much of a use, but I think a high damage but lower ammo should make it cut through enemies better and make it more satisfying at the cost of less use time.
Introduction to the kids levels are slightly altered to work around the new AI
[*]Mouse won’t clip onto tab when out of focus
[/list]

[b]ACT  2- [/b]
[list]
[*]Some annoying zombie placements are changed in the hook platforming intro level
[/list]

[b]ACT  1- [/b]
[list]

notes.title: UNCLE KENNY NEW YEARS UPDATE!! : Combo Meter, Directional Audio and Much More!!
notes.notes:
[b]HELLO GAMERS!!! HAPPY NEW YEAR!![/b]

It is an honor to tell you all that I am back. I wasted a lot of my Winter Break from college on Elden Ring but I have locked in this week and created a few new features. Much more to come!

[u]DIRECTIONAL AUDIO![/u]

- Immerse yourself in the Uncle Kenny World, now with 3D audio!!! 
- As well, the sound now has filters when under the effects of the new drug pickups and more!

[u]COMBO METER!![/u]

- When you kill enemies in succession, you'll get a number showing your combo that will shrink and go away unless you kill more and take minimal damage!
- Win coins when you do well!
- Some balancing to come, but excited to launch the new feature. My first use of Gamemaker's GUI features

[u]New Powerups![/u]

- Snails can now drop jump boosts!
- Druggie enemies can now drop drugs that boost your speed!
- A new level in the middle of the act that uses the powerups for platforming
- In act 2, hellhounds can drop speed boosts and bats can drop jump boosts as well

[u]Bees![/u]

- Bees now roam the early areas in the game, designed by my girlfriend Ava!
- In one level, you can shoot a bee hive that can attack enemies. Will add that to a few more levels soon, but wanted to make sure that the balance was alright first.

[u]General Fixes - [/u]
- Signs are now much more readable, although their large size may create a few clipping issues, will fix soon,
- The pause menu has been fixed, now reaches the center of the screen at all times, and you can now go to the menu by pressing M. I think I'm going to let you go to the options menu from there as well. To be added soon.
- You can now press the "F" key to see all UI elements at once for a period of time.
- Act 2's cemetery location is now home to an old and abandoned Armory Building, a tease of Act 3
- A welcome to High Hill Trail sign is added to the first level.
- Various graphics can be seen around the previously empty gray buildings, such as posters for Hank The Survival Guy and Uncle Kenny For Mayor!
- Carl's shop glitch fixes, and adjusted prices slightly for inflation. 
- The comics inside of Carl's shop are now more readable.



[b]Sorry for the rushed update, I am super excited to get these features out and will be patching issues very soon. HAPPY NEW YEAR!! Excited for the final year of Uncle Kenny, almost 2 years since this slow burn journey started, and more than 3 years since I started the development. Thank you all! Heck yeah![/b]

[u]Gamers, I'm pleased to announce that this is officially the final major patch before the launch of Act 3. I'm not sure how long it will take for the final version 3.00 to release, but in the mean time, enjoy a huge content update for acts 1 and 2.[/u]

notes.title: AN UPDATE ON ACT 2 OF UNCLE KENNY THE GAME
notes.notes:
[b]HELLO GAMERS[/b]

Today is a very special update on the development of the coming free update titled ACT 2.

First off, to clear any confusion-

Act 2 is a [u]FREE[/u] update for anyone that currently owns Uncle Kenny The Game.
The general price for new players will be raised to $2.99 on the day of release. Similarly, this summer, when the final act releases, the price will be raised to a final $3.99. 

[u]WHAT IS INCLUDED IN THIS UPDATE?!?! [/u]

- The next chapter of the Uncle Kenny story, with a theme of horror partly inspired by Resident Evil 4 (2005) and the explorative sections or Resident Evil Village.

- THE [b]FLAMETHROWER[/b]

- Some new surprises and familiar weapons.

- A lot of new platforming mechanics.

-A RELEASE OF UNCLE KENNY THE GAME ON MAC!

[u]WHAT IS THE RELEASE DATE?? [/u]

Originally, I had hoped to launch Act 2 on April 20th. As the day gets closer, I've realized that there is a lot of polish work left to complete, and I want to get this launch right so that I can start work on the final ACT 3 as soon as possible for a July release date.

So, my new and likely final release date has been moved to [b]MAY 15TH[/b] The two month anniversary of the original launch. On that note, I'd also like to release Act 3 on July 15th, although I cant say for sure if that's plausible as I have a lot of work left to complete until I can say for sure.

I WANT TO THANK EVERYONE FOR PLAYING UNCLE KENNY AND I LOOK FORWARD TO MORE UPDATES AS THE MAY 15 RELEASE DATE COMES CLOSER!

[u]GOALS ID LIKE TO REACH BY THE END OF THE SUMMER[/u]

-Steam Achievements
-1v1 Couch Co-op battle mode
-A more in depth hard mode difficulty
- A LAUNCH ON PLAYSTATION 5!!!

notes.title: UNCLE KENNY VERSION 1.15 HOTFIX
notes.notes:
[b]SOME FINAL CHANGES[/b]

This is a smaller hotfix, only a few minor changes.
- You can no longer soar to the sky with the shotgun using the number keys, Uncle Kenny cannot escape his simulation no matter how hard he tries.
- Optimized grapple hook section, removed over 1,700 instances and enhanced accuracy of the grapple shot, reducing the chance of unfair failed connections
- Slightly reduced the chance of Uncle Kenny talking in order to further prevent him from independent thinking
- Some minor soft lock fixes
- Reduced the random spread of the machine gun as a result of player feedback.

[b]THIS IS LIKELY THE LAST PATCH UNTIL ACT 2. ENJOY!![/b]

notes.title: UNCLE KENNY VERSION 1.1 UPDATE!!!
notes.notes:
[b]A NEW VERSION OF UNCLE KENNY IS NOW HERE!![/b]

These past few days I have been working on Act 2, but there were still a few things that I went back and fixed on Act 1, including:

- Uncle Kenny can no longer escape his prison by walking to the left immediately following the start of a new level in the opening levels of the game.
- Inspired by the modern masterpiece Forespoken, Uncle Kenny now very occasionally speaks during gameplay and grunts when hurt by an enemy.
- Some behind the scenes tuning for Act 2
- Miscellaneous minor fixes.

[b]A NOTE ON THE MAC VERSION OF UNCLE KENNY[/b]

As my subscription to Gamemaker is ending in a few days, this will likely be the last update of the game until when ACT 2 comes out.
[u]AS A RESULT, THE MAC VERSION OF UNCLE KENNY HAS BEEN DELAYED UNTIL APRIL 20th[/u]

I hope to add in Steam achievements at some point as well, but Im currently having trouble implementing the Steam API into my project. I will update whenever new developments come.

GAME ON brothers, and you will see me again this April for ACT 2
